# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(Harman)
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
  library(parallel)
  library(doParallel)
})

base_dir <- "../../.."
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "DATASET", "_HARMONIZATION")
code_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "R")
data_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data_CN_only/preprocessing/ADNI")

source(file.path(code_dir, "harman_functions.R"), local = TRUE)
```

# Define Functions

## Load Data

```{r func_load}
prepare_dnam_metadata <- function(dnam_data, dataset) {
  dnam_data$age_split_by_tertiles <- ntile(dnam_data$Age, 3)
  if (dataset == "FHS") {
    batches <- dnam_data$Batch
    batches <- ifelse(batches == "B0019", "B0018", batches)
    dnam_data$Batch <- batches
  }
  
  dnam_data
}

load_data <- function(dataset) {
  dnam_data <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "DNAm_normalized.RDS"))
  
  dnam_data <- prepare_dnam_metadata(dnam_data, dataset)
  
  dnam_data
}
```

## Batch Correct

```{r func_batch}
get_batch_params <- function(
    dnam_data, batch_var = "Batch", expt_vars = c("sex", "DX")
) {
  pheno_df <- dnam_data %>%
    SummarizedExperiment::colData() %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  batches <- pheno_df %>%
    dplyr::pull(as.name(batch_var)) %>%
    as.character()
  
  expt <- pheno_df %>%
    dplyr::pull(as.name(expt_vars[[1]])) %>%
    as.character()
  
  if (length(expt_vars) > 1) {
    for (expt_var in expt_vars[2:length(expt_vars)]) {
      expt_add <- pheno_df %>%
        dplyr::pull(as.name(expt_var)) %>%
        as.character()
      expt <- paste0(expt, "_", expt_add)
    }
  }
  
  expt <- as.factor(expt)
  batches <- as.factor(batches)
  
  list(batch = batches, expt = expt)
}

batch_data <- function(
    dnam_data,
    batch_var = "Batch",
    expt_vars = c("sex", "DX"),
    randseed = 42,
    max_pc = 1000
) {
  batch_params <- get_batch_params(
    dnam_data,
    batch_var = batch_var,
    expt_vars = expt_vars
  )
  batch <- batch_params$batch
  expt <- batch_params$expt
  
  m_data <- SummarizedExperiment::assays(dnam_data)$dnam %>%
    Harman::shiftBetas(shiftBy = 1e-4) %>%
    lumi::beta2m()
  
  if (max_pc >= ncol(dnam_data)) {
    use_full <- TRUE
    harman_data <- Harman::harman(
      m_data,
      expt = expt,
      batch = batch,
      limit = 0.95,
      randseed = randseed
    )    
  } else {
    use_full <- FALSE
    harman_data <- harman_adjusted(
      m_data,
      expt = expt,
      batch = batch,
      limit = 0.95,
      randseed = randseed,
      max_pc = max_pc
    )
  }
  
  list(harman_data = harman_data, use_full = use_full)
}

reconstruct_data <- function(dnam_data, harman_data, use_full = TRUE) {
  if (use_full) {
    correct_data <- Harman::reconstructData(harman_data)
  } else {
    correct_data <- reconstructData_adjusted(harman_data)
  }
  
  correct_data <- lumi::m2beta(correct_data)
  correct_data <- SummarizedExperiment::SummarizedExperiment(
    assays = list(dnam = correct_data),
    rowData = dnam_data %>%
      SummarizedExperiment::rowData(),
    colData = dnam_data %>%
      SummarizedExperiment::colData()
  )
  
  correct_data
}
```

## Wrapper Function

```{r func_wrapper}
process_dataset <- function(dataset, expt_vars, max_pc = 1000) {
  message("Start ", dataset)
  dnam_data <- load_data(dataset)
  batch_res <- batch_data(
    dnam_data, batch_var = "Batch", expt_vars = expt_vars, max_pc = max_pc
  )
  harman_data <- batch_res$harman_data
  use_full <- batch_res$use_full
  
  message("Batched ", dataset)
  
  correct_data <- reconstruct_data(dnam_data, harman_data, use_full = use_full)
  
  saveRDS(
    correct_data,
    file.path(data_dir, "DNAm_batched.RDS")
  )
}
```

# Run

```{r run}
process_dataset(dataset = "ADNI", expt_vars = "age_split_by_tertiles", max_pc = 750)
```
